caption: The drawing features a decorative pattern consisting of stylized botanical and animal forms. The background is a light beige or cream color. The objects within the design are primarily composed of shapes resembling flowers, leaves, and paisley motifs, rendered in various colors, including brown, green, blue, pink, and yellowish-tan. Scattered among the botanical shapes are stylized animal figures, including at least two deer-like creatures, depicted in brown with minimal detail. Floral motifs are rendered in brown, pink, green, and blue, with some flowers having multiple concentric layers of color. The pattern is denser on the right side and along the borders, where the elements are aligned in vertical and horizontal rows. The right and bottom edges feature a repeating arrangement of paisley shapes, curving leaves, and flowers, creating a distinct border. The central portion of the image contains a more scattered composition, with randomly oriented flora and fauna interspersed with abstract forms and curved lines. The overall palette is dominated by earthy tones highlighted with brighter pink and blue, and the spacing between the motifs leaves ample background visible throughout the drawing.
title: Colcha
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
